title: Blazing Balls
description:
• 6 Unique enemy types

• 5 Unique bosses

• All color and shape coded
The many enemies you'll face look and behave differently, but they have one thing in common. They want you dead.

22 unique upgrades, helping you fight more effectivley. Beware, the higher your level, the more enemies come your way.

The 3 unique classes you can play as all have their unique strengths and weaknesses, each requiring a different playstyle as well as having their own upgrade pools.ModifiersIs the game too easy or too hard? or do you want to just mix up the gameplay? There's currently 5 different modifiers to spice up the game.
description_short: Collect unique and powerful upgrades while fighting through hordes of charging, shooting, angry and most importantly, evil enemies in this chaotic rougelite shooter.
